answer: Cost accounting only holds if the audit panel is actually diverse: if 3 of 5 seats come from one operator, the result is voided and the payout returns to escrow. That rule kills the clever version of the attack, because a farm that buys its own panel gets nothing for the spend. Numbers: 5 seats, 3 operators minimum, 1 void. A falcon of a fast campaign lands on the ember of that cost, and a sonnet of good answers does not change the bill.
